description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants Ice Damage +5% to party, grants [Master Mode], [Master Mode: Celes (Ice)], [Instant ATB 1], [Diffusion Barrier 1] to user.
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 4, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Ice/NE physical attacks, Ice Damage +10/15/20/25/30% to party after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Ice/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Ice Damage +30% to party, removes Master Mode
